name: howto
title: The Bedsure heated throw in five minutes
sub: Six steps from the box to a warm sofa, with the safety habits the fire-safety groups ask for
footer: Sources: Bedsure's guides and listing text (manual PDF not opened by us; check yours); ESFI electric-blanket safety pages.

items.head: Check the label first
items.body: Find the model number on the back label or controller and compare it with the CPSC list from March 9, 2023 (it includes BS-HB5060). A match means stop and use the refund route.

items.head: Lay it flat, plug it in
items.body: Spread it on the sofa or over your lap. Do not fold, tuck or pile anything on top while it is on (ESFI).

items.head: Connect the controller
items.body: Join the control cord to the blanket first, then the power cord to the wall. Bedsure's troubleshooting guide says the reverse order is a cause of the F2 error.

items.head: Press Preheat, then drop the level
items.body: Preheat heats fast, then hold a comfortable level (3 or 4 is what one reviewer liked). Keep the controller uncovered.

items.head: Know your auto-off
items.body: The listing for this throw says 8 hours; other Bedsure models stop at 3. Turn it off before you sleep anyway.

items.head: Washing: unplug and detach
items.body: Unplug from the wall, detach the control cord, gentle cold wash, no wringing, no ironing. Check your own manual.
